finding.text: Snag 2 misses a modified task log: `branchTaskDirs` in `Server/merge.mjs` (the new function, about line 174) trims each `git status --porcelain` line and then does `l.slice(3)`. A tracked file with unstaged changes (` M public/…/task.jsonl`, which is what `review.mjs` makes when it appends a review line) becomes `ublic/…`, fails the `public/framework/ai/` check and is skipped. Don't trim the status lines; split on the first space after the two status characters. The new test in `Server/merge.test.mjs` only covers an untracked file (`??`), so add a case for a modified one.

The task folder doesn't record the extra work. Commit ec10f6c70 ("snags 5, 6": `tasks.add` on a session route goes to `session.jsonl`, and a page write answers small, in `Servex/agents/page_tools.js`) and `Server/IgnoredImageLinks.mjs` (merge warns on links to git-ignored pictures) are not in `requirements.md`. No file in the task folder says who asked for them or why. Add the asks to `requirements.md` or the task log.

A fresh agent couldn't continue from this folder. It holds only `requirements.md`, `past-work.md`, a one-line `session.jsonl` (the assign line) and `review/`. There is no task log, no outcome, and no record of the proof runs the brief asks for: each snag's test or rerun, and `run-all --browser` beside another headless job. That proof appears only as prose in `core/Test/doc/health.md`. Link the run lines (results.jsonl / run-all.jsonl) and the test results from the task folder.

The brief asked the builder to coordinate with `mastermind-task-close-loop` before touching `Servex/agents/Agents.js`, and the diff changes `Agents.successor()` (one line). Nothing records that coordination.

The new check in `public/framework/core/Test/TestRunner.test.mjs` doesn't test the fallback. `real.wav_path()` passes whenever the path ends in `jfk.wav`, and the worktree's own missing path does too. A case with a scratch "main" checkout that holds the wav would prove snag 4's fix.

A page write through `page_set`/`page_add` (`page_tools.js` about line 1396) no longer returns the page's text. Any caller that read the page out of a write's answer now needs a separate read. `Servex/doc/item-tool.md` documents the change, but it goes beyond the four snags.

`review.mjs --shots-only` on a diff of size `none` reaches the `size === "none"` branch (`Server/review.mjs:761`) before the shots-only exit, so it writes a no-agent pass review line. The flag's comment promises "no review line". This is harmless (no page means no shots), but the wording is wrong.

Snag 1's own wording ("isn't a live agent") no longer appears anywhere in `Servex/`. The fix traces the false failure to `successor()` following a shared `session_id`, and adds `ok`, `delivered_to` and `note` to the card. The readme says Servex needs a restart, and the report must say so too, as the brief asks.
`Server/readme.md` lists neither `OutPath.mjs` nor `IgnoredImageLinks.mjs`. It doesn't list `MergeTests.mjs` either, so this follows the existing pattern; `Server/doc/review.md` does document both.
